subject: Rollout Playbook & 60-Day Ops Checkpoints — LumenRx integration
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@lumenrx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rollout Playbook & 60-Day Ops Checkpoints — LumenRx integration

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I’m sharing a compact rollout playbook and an initial set of operational checkpoints for the first 60 days. The goal here is to make the handoff to your implementation and ops teams frictionless and to lock down the dates we’ll hold for dry-runs and the go/no-go preflight.

High-level request: please confirm owners for the LumenRx side below and whether the proposed dates work (I included a one-week buffer where possible). If anything needs to shift, flag the items and we’ll iterate.

Proposed milestones (owners = Redwood / LumenRx):
- Week 1 (2025-06-16): API credential exchange & allowlist — Olga / Sam (deliverable: API_Credentials_Checklist.xlsx)
- Week 2 (2025-06-23): Integration smoke tests (staging) — Ben / LumenRx IT (deliverable: smoke-test report)
- Week 4 (2025-07-07): Dry-run of full pipeline (staging, scripted assertions) — Mina / LumenRx IT (deliverable: Dryrun_Script_v2.txt, results)
- Week 6 (2025-07-21): Preflight review & runbook sign-off — Karthik / Sam (deliverable: Transition_Playbook_v1.pdf v2)
- Week 8 (2025-08-04): Go-live window (production cutover) — Ops on both sides (deliverable: cutover checklist & incident bridge schedule)

Risk/contingency highlights:
- If the staging smoke test uncovers auth issues we’ll scope a one-week remediation slot and run a focused regression.
- We’ll maintain a 2-hour daily bridge on dry-run days and a 24/7 on-call rotation for the 48 hours following go-live.

Attachments: Transition_Playbook_v1.pdf (playbook draft), API_Credentials_Checklist.xlsx, Dryrun_Script_v2.txt.

Next step: can you confirm Sam (or an alternate) as the day-to-day point and whether procurement needs a separate procurement timeline? I’ve looped procurement@ for visibility.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollout Playbook & 60-Day Ops Checkpoints — LumenRx integration

Olga — thanks for the clear plan. Two quick internal notes:

1) I’ll own the staging smoke-test orchestration but suggest we add an integration owner for the LumenRx side (networking / allowlist) — Sam, can you confirm who on your IT team owns firewall/egress rules?

2) Our QA lead is out 06/22–06/26; I recommend running the smoke tests on 06/23 as you proposed but accept that any failures discovered during the QA lead’s absence will be triaged first and scheduled for the remediation window (week of 06/30).

I’ll prepare the smoke-test harness and post results to the shared Drive link.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Customer Success Manager
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@lumenrx.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenrx.com, LumenRx IT <it@lumenrx.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rollout Playbook & 60-Day Ops Checkpoints — LumenRx integration

Thanks, Olga — this looks good and much appreciated. A couple of asks from our side:

- Can we move the dry-run from 2025-07-07 to 2025-07-14? Our lead integration engineer will be on leave the earlier week.
- Procurement requests that we insert a billing/contract milestone in Week 3 (target 2025-06-30) so they can align the PO and billing start date with our finance cycle. I’ve CC’d procurement.

Owners from our side:
- Day-to-day integration: Priya Menon (priya.menon@lumenrx.com) — she will be added to the Drive folder and the bridge invites.
- Network / allowlist: LumenRx IT (it@lumenrx.com) — please coordinate port / IP allowlist with them.

If you can shift the dry-run to 07/14 and add the procurement milestone on 06/30, we’re in good shape to proceed.

—Sam
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@lumenrx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, priya.menon@lumenrx.com, procurement@lumenrx.com, LumenRx IT <it@lumenrx.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rollout Playbook & 60-Day Ops Checkpoints — LumenRx integration

Sam — thanks for the updates, noted and accepted. I’ve updated the timeline below and attached an amended playbook (v1.1) with the procurement milestone included. New dates:

- API credential exchange: 2025-06-16 — Olga / Priya Menon
- Staging smoke tests: 2025-06-23 — Ben / LumenRx IT
- Procurement sign-off / PO issued: 2025-06-30 — procurement@lumenrx.com / Redwood Finance
- Dry-run (staging): 2025-07-14 — Mina / Priya Menon / LumenRx IT
- Preflight sign-off: 2025-07-28 — Karthik / Sam
- Production cutover window: 2025-08-04 — joint ops

Action items assigned:
- Priya Menon (LumenRx): confirm API access and populate API_Credentials_Checklist.xlsx by 2025-06-16.
- LumenRx IT: provide allowlist IPs and confirm test connectivity by 2025-06-19.
- Ben Carter (Redwood): deliver smoke-test report to Drive on 2025-06-24.
- Mina Haddad (Redwood): lead dry-run; build incident scenarios and run bridge on 2025-07-14.
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood): compile preflight runbook and checklist by 2025-07-21 for review.

I’ve added Priya to the thread for day-to-day coordination. I’ll circulate calendar invites for the staging smoke test and the dry-run bridge later today.

Attachments: Transition_Playbook_v1.1.pdf (amendment), API_Credentials_Checklist.xlsx.

—Olga
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@lumenrx.com>, priya.menon@lumenrx.com

All — quick confirmations from my side:

- I’ve staged the smoke-test harness and will push results to the Drive link by 2025-06-24 EOD (action: Ben).
- Internal note: I’ve reserved an engineering QA slot for remediation week (2025-06-30 to 07-03) in case we need it.
- Mina — I’ll pair with you on incident scenarios for the dry-run; let me know a good time tomorrow to sync.

If there are no objections, I’ll convert Olga’s playbook into the shared folder and tag deliverables so we have a single source of truth.

Thanks — Ben
